hook: Toolformer (Schick et al., 2023) started self-supervised tool annotation. Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard V4 (Patil et al., 2025) sets the 2026 bar: 40% agentic, 30% multi-turn, 10% live, 10% non-live, 10% hallucination. Single-turn is solved. Memory, dynamic decision-making, and long-horizon tool chains are not.
